concerns.text: FR-000 requires verification that Participant IDs match across composite datasets when a Within‑Subjects design is attempted. No task in tasks.md checks ID matching; T003 and T004 only validate column presence and size. Add a task (e.g., T003b) that cross‑checks participant ID overlap and aborts or flags design selection accordingly.
Task T016 (Document methods & results handoff) is not referenced anywhere in plan.md, making it an orphan task. Either integrate it into the implementation plan or remove it.
Task T017 (Re‑run full workflow from scratch for reproducibility) is also absent from plan.md, resulting in an orphan task. Align it with the plan or delete it.

Task T008 performs Benjamini‑Hochberg correction but does not explicitly state validation against `contracts/analysis_output.schema.yaml`. Add a validation sub‑step or a separate task to ensure the output conforms to the schema.
